in_sanskrit.name: जल्प
in_sanskrit.meaning: to make a loud noise or clamor
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jalpa is derived from the Sanskrit word जल्प (jalp), which means 'to make a loud noise' or 'clamor'. It is also found in Hindu mythology as the name of a river goddess and a goddess of wealth.

in_marathi.name: Jalpa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jalpa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'jalp' meaning 'to flow'. Jalpa is the name of a goddess who is believed to bring prosperity and abundance. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted with a pot of water, symbolizing the nurturing and life-giving qualities of water.
